title: The motes: a smaller gliding ivory at 2.5x the white's ground speed, traded for a share of the amoebas in sectors 1-5
context: The owner, round 14 (2026-11-13): "Keep the whites as they are, and introduce an even smaller category of whites that glide at 2x or 3x". The morning's WHITE_RUSH 1.2 is the fastest a hopping white can go without popping in the motion audit (test/pearl-motion.mjs: a hop's peak speed is its mean over the transfer x 1.875, the pop 0.25 radii a frame). The kit already had a glide (PEARL_PACE[tier].glide, retired for every tier by THE SKY MODEL, 2026-10-30); glide is per pool, and a pool was per tier.
outcome: A new enemy type `mote` (THE MOTE, Cutis-Soft Ivory's glider): ENEMY_SPEC.mote (the amoeba's record: hp 1, speed 1.5, size 0.5, rammable, bounty 2, shelved from the legacy INTROS programme only), PEARL_OF white (its skin, belt, bestiary entry, kill belt), drawn in a pool of its own (PEARL_GLIDERS.mote.pool 'mote', PEARL_POOL_OF; src/domain/pearl-bodies.js `pools`, src/fx/creature-pearl.js keys pools by it and draws the pool's tier's skin). PEARL_GLIDERS.mote: scale 0.42 (white 0.65: r0 1.18 m against the amoeba's 1.82), rush 2.5 (its cap 5.57 of its own radii a second = 6.55 m/s, 2.5 x the amoeba's 2.62), hp 0.4 (white 0.6), heart 0.1; PEARL_PACE.mote glide true; PEARL_FOLLOW.capacity.mote 1000. Warm under the gunship FLIR (a soft pool: PEARL_FOLLOW.thermal.soft). The waves: SECTOR_MOTES (src/content/sectors.js) trades a share of every sized wave's amoebas for motes in sectors 1-5 (1: 0.3, 2: 0.3, 3: 0.25, 4: 0.2, 5: 0.2), the wave's total kept, the motes' entry first (src/domain/sector-shape.js shareOut). Found on the way: the motion audit booked every glided frame as a re-placement (sw.place bumps `placed`) and measured none, so the gliding blobs of 2026-10-16 were never audited; a glide's place now keeps `placed`, and the mote is audited for real. In the game the first --pearl-story run on the motes measured 6 centre pops and 1 shape pop in 8,664 mote frames (steps 0.3-0.5 radii a frame, a decaying catch-up after the record's target jumped): a gliding body now slides at most PEARL_GAIT.glideMax 12 radii a second (the pop is 15). The white is untouched (1.2 x WHITE_RUSH radii, hopping).
alternatives: A ninth tier: rejected for the box, it fans into the tier table's ladder tests (sizes and aggression grow with rank), the bestiary's eight-tier roster, the membranes and the tune panel; the mote is a type of the white tier in its own pool, the brief's allowed variant.
A per-body glide flag inside the white pool: rejected, the pool's config (stride, timing) is the white's hop, and the glide/paceOf branches are per pool already.
Rushing the hopping white past 1.2: rejected this morning (the audit's pops), the owner's note keeps the whites as they are.
evidence: test/pearl-motion.mjs (the follow harness, 20 s, 4 records a type, jittery frames): the mote's record 7.07 m/s = 2.63 x the amoeba's 2.69 (the amoeba's record waits for its hopping body); the drawn centre's path 6.98 m/s = 2.20 x the amoeba's 3.16 (a hopping body's own sideways motion lengthens the amoeba's); 0 centre and 0 shape pops, 0 hops, 0 re-placed, worst 10.18 radii a second, accel p95 21; a record put 30 m on in one frame is slid to at glideMax. Before the audit fix the same run booked the mote's every frame as replaced (3,811) and measured 0 frames.

--pearl-story (source, through the lock): before the glide cap red at 'no Pearl body jumps in a frame' twice: run 1 white 0/2 pops (coil, point 0.54 against 0.5; the white pool untouched), mote 0/0; run 2 mote 6/1, white 0/0. After the cap (3a67bae3): green, mote 6 bodies 8.6k frames 0/0, white 56 hops 0/0. Base (.worktrees/base) the same hour: green, white 0/0. Run once after the cap only.

Waves (test/sector-shape.mjs, the pulse rows at waveSize 4, x PEARL_WAVES.crowd): sector 1 amoeba 21/42/19/24 -> 15/29/13/17 + mote 6/13/6/7; sector 2 42/21/23/0 -> 29/15/16/0 + 13/6/7/0; sector 3 18/24/0/57 -> 13/18/0/43 + 5/6/0/14; every wave's total unchanged. In the game's sector 2 the suite's census by type listed mote 8 Pearl bodies, 0 dot clouds (the sector's waves and the harness's spawns together; not split).

Screen size (--dead-probe PLAN=amoeba:8,mote:8 KILL=0 POSE=45,70, day 3): a mote 10.3-11.7 px of radius against an amoeba's 15.4 (0.67), drawn and seen; .superpowers/scratch/motes-shot/probe-kill-day-f5.png. Thermal: test/pearl-thermal.mjs, the mote pool made in the seat runs warm (PEARL_FOLLOW.thermal.soft 0.5).
npm test 352 programs passed before and after the cap commit, npm run check, npm run architecture green; td-tab unchanged (5,365).
